title: Siege of Strasbourg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Strasbourg", at revision 1370745511, opens: "The siege of Strasbourg took place during the Franco-Prussian War, and resulted in the French surrender of the fortress on 28 September 1870." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q620012, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege during the Franco-German war in 1870". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
